name: Death from Below
text:
**Death from Below** (Combat)

You have been trained to fight flying creatures.

**Prerequisites**: Base attack bonus +1.

**Benefit**: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus against
 flying opponents when you have set a weapon against a
 charge, or when you are allowed an attack of opportunity
 against the flying opponent.
